title: Zero Hour | ECHO//100 Episode 20
description:
Kavi confronts the truth behind the fractured sky as the missing hour threatens to consume the city. The reality of the Red Door is shattered, forcing a permanent integration of time that leaves the citizens staring at their new master. Episode 20 of ECHO//100: ARC. This is a work of original fiction.

This is original AI-assisted animated fiction.

scenes.text: The massive clock tower strikes thirteen, turning the city sky into a pulsing, ominous blood-red void.
scenes.caption: Thirteen strikes.
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi in red hoodie and glasses standing in the city square, looking up at a massive clock tower with a cracked, glowing red sky.

scenes.text: The Red Door flickers, revealing it is not an exit, but a filter obscuring a terrifying truth.
scenes.caption: The filter reveals.
scenes.image_prompt: A glowing, semi-transparent red doorway hovering above the square, showing glimpses of a dark, forgotten world behind it.

scenes.text: Kavi feels Null’s memories clawing at his mind, urging him to collapse the door and save reality.
scenes.caption: Conflicting memories surge.
scenes.image_prompt: Close-up of Kavi’s face, one eye glowing red, his expression a mix of pain and intense determination.

scenes.text: If he seals the door, the city survives, but the missing hour will be erased from history.
scenes.caption: The impossible choice.
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi reaching out toward the floating red light, his backpack straps visible, the city frozen in anticipation around him.

scenes.text: Mira appears as a hologram, pleading with Kavi to let the raw, unfiltered time wash over them.
scenes.caption: Mira’s final plea.
scenes.image_prompt: Mira in her blue holographic teal coat standing beside Kavi, her hands glowing as she points to the sky.

scenes.text: Kavi ignores the warnings and shatters the filter, flooding the streets with the trapped, missing hour.
scenes.caption: The filter breaks.
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi slamming his fist into the air, causing the red sky to explode into shards of white, blinding light.

scenes.text: Time halts instantly, freezing every vehicle and falling raindrop in a beautiful, silent, temporal prism of glass.
scenes.caption: Time stands still.
scenes.image_prompt: A wide shot of the city square, everything frozen in mid-air, with Kavi standing at the center of the stillness.

scenes.text: Every citizen wakes up simultaneously, eyes locking onto Kavi with a chilling, synchronized, and knowing intensity.
scenes.caption: The city awakens.
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi surrounded by hundreds of citizens who have all turned their heads to stare directly at him.
